mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relations.sys_email_send_limit (scope_key, send_date, send_count, last_sent_at) VALUES (#{scopeKey}, #{sendDate}, 0, #{initialTime}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT scope_key, send_date, send_count, last_sent_at FROM relations.sys_email_send_limit WHERE scope_key = #{scopeKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relations.sys_email_code (email) VALUES (#{email}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT email, code_hash, expires_at, failed_attempts, used FROM relations.sys_email_code WHERE email = #{email} FOR UPDATE
